title: Sitar Legend Forever - Medium
description: Sitar Legend Forever - Medium — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A //TEMP

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 3, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Medium mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_A //TEMP

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 3, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Medium mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

Just because you beat Sitar Hero on Medium doesn't mean that you can't play it again on that skill level if you wish. Maybe Hard is too hard for you and you just want to practice your skills. Maybe you just really like rocking out on a sub-par level and have no ambition in life, much less in Sitar Hero. Who am I to judge?!

You will find the teleporter to play Sitar Hero on Medium in Mutanous Malaise, Level 3. Again, it is guarded by some creatures that love them some Sitar Hero, so expect a fight. Return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, here in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine when you have beaten Sitar Hero on Medium.

Turn-in:

Mediocrity is Gosh's gift to you, Dungeon Runner. Know this and hold it close to your moderately resolute heart and adequately firm resolve! Let me know if you would like to play Sitar Hero on Medium again.

Objectives:

  • 10 Polkadot Notes ×10
  • 10 Plaid Notes ×10
  • 10 Paisley Notes ×10

Client level range: 33–55
